chunks.text: Matching Paragraph Heading
Assalamualaikum
In today's class we will discuss about
Matching Paragraph Heading in IELTS Reading General Training Section
We have discussed about Matching Paragraph Heading in this course
Tips and techniques are similar to Matching Paragraph Heading and Matching Paragraph Information
The only difference is that you have to give some heading to the paragraph
You have to decide which heading matches with which paragraph
For Paragraph Information, the only difference is that
they will give you a statement and you have to decide which paragraph this statement is in
So, tips and techniques are almost same, you just have to find different things
We will work on the basic concept of a paragraph
We will try to find a paragraph heading with the idea of a full paragraph
This heading will give us the idea of a full paragraph
One of the advantages of Matching Paragraph Information is that
we have to find the specific information in the matching paragraph information
We have to read the paragraph carefully to find the specific information
If we talk about some strategies, we can easily follow them
First, we will read the text for general understanding
We did the same thing for Matching Paragraph Heading
We read the text for general understanding
Then, read the statement carefully
Identify the keywords and phrases in the question
Mark the keywords like this
Think about the synonyms and paraphrases that can be used in the reading test
As I told you before, it is not necessary to use the same words in the same paragraph
Sometimes, the same words are used in the same sentence
So, think about the synonyms and paraphrases that can be used in the reading test
Locate the question statement in the text
Most of the time, the question statement is not in the same paragraph
It is the same meaning but different words are used
If you can locate the statement in the text, underline it like this
Check the underline sentence and finalize the answer
Then, you can do it
Repeat steps 2-4 for each question and match the information
We will discuss three important tips to match the information in the paragraph
Answer this item at the end
Because, you have read the paragraph many times before answering the questions
And, you have got the idea of the entire paragraph
You have got an idea of the entire passage
So, we can get the idea of the entire passage
Answer the question at the end
Then, you can get the idea of the entire passage
Identify the names, places and numbers in the question
Because, it is easy to find them in the text
The question is often called names, places and numbers
If you can identify them, it is easy to find them in the text
Because, they are not called paraphrase
They are often found in the text and in the question
Be careful about synonyms and paraphrase
For example, if 34% of the question is said, then it can be said just over a third in the text
It can be said about a third in the text
Be careful about this
If 34% of the question is said, then it can be said just over a third in the text
It can be said about a third in the text
Same goes for about a third
The meaning of about a third is same
Just the words are different
So, be careful about the paraphrase
Now, we will solve a sample question
Where we will try to match the information in the paragraph
At first, you can see
We have been told here
Hobbies for the elderly
We have understood the title here
It is talking about the hobbies or hobbies of the elderly
The first one is card making
This has become an increasingly popular hobby
As it is very easy to start
And cards can be as simple or complicated as skills allow
It is becoming more popular as a hobby
And it is very easy to start playing cards
Because we can make the card games easy or difficult according to our skill level
Best of all, it is a lovely way for your parents to send wishes to all family and friends
It means, the card making
We can make the card levels complex or easy
According to our skill level
It is very good for parents
Because parents can make cards and wish to others, family and friends on various occasions
I understood
In the second paragraph, they told us about art
This can be done at your parents' home or in a local art class
It can be done in your parents' house or in a local art class
It can be painting, drawing, sculpture or pottery
It means, painting, drawing, sculpture, pottery can be done in any of these
It does not matter how skilled your parent is
As there are opportunities for all levels
It does not matter how skilled your parent is
As there are opportunities for all levels
Try it once
The creative process here is very rewarding
It means, we get a lot from here
It is a great way for your elderly relative to meet new people
It will be a great opportunity to meet new people
Learning to use the internet
It is another benefit
It means, learn to use the internet
If your aging parent likes the look of new technology but has never learned how to use it
The internet is very easy
Once someone has shown them how
If your aging parent likes the technology but has never learned how to use it
The internet can be a great way for them
Through which they can learn a lot
Only if someone teaches them
It creates a lot of new possibilities for us
Through this, they can easily stay in contact with their grandparents
We have covered card making, art and learning to use the internet
Now, we will see the questions
What did they tell us first?
Which section has this information?
Very important
It means, note that the paragraphs are labeled as A, B and C
You have also been told to write A, B and C
You have to write the answer as the label of the paragraph
What did they tell us first?
A way to learn new methods of communication
A way to learn new methods of communication
It means, a way to learn new ways of communicating
In which paragraph, this information is mentioned?
We will see a new method of communication
What will we see if we try to find the answer?
We have been told a way to learn new methods of communication
It means, a way to learn new ways of communicating
Let's see where it is
We have read in this section that
The internet is very easy once someone has shown them how
It means, it is very easy to use the internet if someone teaches us
It opens up a whole new world of information
And they will be able to keep in touch easily with their children and grandchildren via email
It means, it opens up a new world for them
And they can easily communicate with their grandchildren through email
This is a new form of communication
It means, we can create a new form of communication for our parents
By teaching them how to use the internet
Then our answer will be C
A way to socialize
What did we learn about art?
It does not matter how skilled your parents are
As there are opportunities for all levels
It means, it does not matter how talented your parents are
It opens up opportunities for everyone
The creative process is very absorbing and rewarding
The creative process of Akak is very rewarding
You can get a lot from it
And it is a great way for your elderly relative to meet new people
It is a very unusual way to meet your elderly relatives
We got the answer to the question, A way to socialize
And we got the answer in our paragraph number B
It is a great way for your elderly relative to meet new people
It is a great way to meet new people
It is a great way to get into the art class
We got the answer to the question, C
And the second answer, B
The correct answer is, A way to learn new methods of communication
And the correct answer is option C
Why?
We can find the answer from the line we have bolded on the screen
Email is a new method of communication for parents
And they can keep in touch with their children through email
So, this is a new method of communication
Email is a new method of communication
That is why we got the answer, C
Then we gave the answer, B
The answer is, C
Because, creative process is a very absorbing and rewarding
And it is a great way for your elderly relative to meet new people
It is a great way to meet your elderly relatives
That is why art is a great hobby
And that is why we decided that option B is correct
We have completed the paragraph information matching class
I hope you will not face any problem in matching the paragraph information in the future
In IELTS general training reading section
We will meet again in the next class with a new topic
Take care
